text:
Asha: Quick UX bug I hit in Prompt Evals sample inspector — when I toggle between runs the sample pane sometimes snaps back to the top and loses my annotation context. repro: open run A -> click sample #42 -> toggle 'Show diff' -> switch to run B -> come back to run A and scroll position is reset.
Tom: Hmm, I think we've seen a couple reports like this. Is this only when the diff view is on or also plain sample view?
Asha: Only reliably with diff view, but sometimes with the compact list too. The annoying part is you lose the inline comment thread you were reading.
Jordan: Could be a React keying / DOM remount issue when we swap run objects. I can take a look — do we have a minimal repro? any network logs?
Asha: I recorded a quick gif. Also saw console warning: `Warning: findDOMNode is deprecated` when toggling. attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/placeholder
Maya: Accessibility concern: when focus moves due to scroll jump, keyboard/VO users lose their place. We should ensure focus is preserved on the active sample and announce any view changes. For VoiceOver ideally we announce "Diff view loaded for sample 42" rather than just jumping.
Luca: Product note — this hits reviewers doing regression triage. Loss of context slows down approval flow. If it's non-trivial to fully fix, can we add a temporary affordance: a small sticky breadcrumb that shows "Viewing sample 42 in run A (diff)" and keyboard shortcut to return to last focused sample?
Jordan: Agree on fallback. I'll try to reproduce and then propose a fix: 1) preserve sample id in route/query string, 2) avoid full remount of the sample pane when toggling diff, 3) scroll anchoring to the focused element. If step 2 is tricky we can implement Luca's sticky breadcrumb.
Tom: For the UI copy, small tweak: the toggle currently labeled `Show diff` is ambiguous when in compact mode. Maybe `Show regression diff` or `Side-by-side diff` depending on layout. Also add an aria-label that explains it toggles the annotated diff overlay.
Maya: +1 on aria-labels. Also ensure the toggle has `aria-pressed` state and focus-visible styles. For the announcement text, proposal: "Diff view opened for sample {{id}}. Press M to jump to comments."
Asha: I sketched a tiny microflow — when a user opens a sample we persist lastFocusedSample per user for the run, so if they switch away & back we restore scroll and comment focus. Low-risk fallback if the remount fix takes time.
Jordan: Good. I'll aim to push a small PR with route persistence and breadcrumb within this sprint. If maintainers want, I can include the `findDOMNode` removal in the same change.
Luca: Prioritization: this should be P2 for next sprint — impacts reviewer efficiency but not data integrity. Please add an entry to the UX board and link the PR once ready.
EvalBot: Automated note: There's an existing flaky-eval test that fails intermittently when sample index changes under load (test id: eval-flaky-117). Cross-linking with this thread.
Tom: Thanks EvalBot — Jordan, can you add a quick integration test that simulates switching runs and asserts focused sample remains the same? Keep it lightweight.
Jordan: Yep, adding unit + e2e steps. Will post PR link when ready.
Asha: Thanks everyone — happy to review copy and the sticky breadcrumb mock. Posting my mini wireframe here: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/sample-inspector-breadcrumbs 
Maya: I'll check the copy and keyboard flows after the PR. Small nit: ensure the breadcrumb is reachable by tab order and has an offscreen label for screenreaders.
Luca: Great, closing loop — I'll create the ticket and assign P2. Tag me if you need prioritization bumped. :thumbsup:
